description: Shared golden vectors for search tokenization. Asserted by Go (functions/loans/test/utils/search) and Dart (apps/loans/test/features/search). If the two implementations disagree, search breaks invisibly - no error, a client simply cannot be found - so any change here must be made in both places in the same PR.

schema.case.name: What the case pins. Purely documentation.
schema.case.path: Which function produces the tokens. See paths below. A case with an unknown or missing path is a test failure, not a skip.
schema.case.input: Arguments to that function, in order.
schema.case.tokens: The exact expected output: deduplicated and sorted ascending. Compare as an ordered list.

paths.tokenize: Tokenize(input...) - the general tokenizer, applied to name and email fields. Lowercases, folds diacritics, emits the full normalized value as its own token (exempt from the 12-character prefix cap, truncated only past 256 runes, which no real value reaches), and prefix-expands every word - and every non-alphanumeric-split sub-word - to lengths 2..12.
paths.phone_tokens: PhoneTokens(input[0]) - mobile numbers only. Takes exactly one input. Strips non-digits, then repeatedly trims a leading 63 or 0 until neither remains, then prefix-expands the canonical form and emits its last 4 digits as a discrete token. Never route a phone number through 'tokenize': it does none of that.

cases.name: two-letter surname is indexed whole (below the 2-char prefix floor)
simple name expands to prefixes from length 2
apostrophe yields the joined form, the split parts, and the full value
hyphen yields the joined form, the split parts, and the full value
long token: prefixes stop at 12 characters, full value is still emitted whole
full email: pasted address matches exactly, and every part is searchable; the joined form is capped at 12 while the full value is not
phone spelling 2 of 3: E.164 with +63 - must equal spelling 1 exactly
phone spelling 3 of 3: country code without + - must equal spellings 1 and 2 exactly
phone: international access code stacks 0 and 63 - trimming each prefix once instead of looping leaves 0639175550142 or 639175550142 and produces a different token set
